agentLogs.metrics.info.appointmentAction: Every appointment-related action your AI took — looking up open slots, booking, rescheduling, or cancelling. Use this alongside 'Appointments Booked' to see how often customers explore booking even if they don't finish.
agentLogs.metrics.info.appointmentBooked: Appointments your AI successfully booked. If a single conversation books more than one appointment, each is counted.
agentLogs.metrics.info.appointmentCancel: Appointments your AI cancelled. Each cancellation is counted, even if multiple happen in the same conversation.
agentLogs.metrics.info.appointmentLinkSh: Times your AI sent a self-serve booking link to a contact instead of completing the booking inline. Counts the link share itself, not whether the contact ended up booking.
agentLogs.metrics.info.appointmentResche: Appointments your AI rescheduled. Each reschedule is counted, even if multiple happen in the same conversation.
agentLogs.metrics.info.avgCallDuration: Average length of a Voice AI call in this period.
agentLogs.metrics.info.avgConversationDu: Average time the AI itself spent processing each conversation — adding up every model call, tool run, and Voice AI call. Doesn't include user typing time or pauses, just AI work.
agentLogs.metrics.info.avgMessagesPerCon: Average AI messages per unique contact. Treats one customer who returns across multiple chats as a single contact, so it's lower than 'Average Messages per Conversation' for repeat customers.
agentLogs.metrics.info.bookingConversion: Of all the customers who looked at open appointment slots, the percentage who actually booked. Empty if no one looked at slots in this period.
agentLogs.metrics.info.botTransfer: Times your AI passed the conversation to a different AI bot (a specialist or back-up bot). Each transfer is counted separately.
agentLogs.metrics.info.breakdown.sentime: Calls split into Positive, Neutral, and Negative based on how the customer sounded. Calls without sentiment (web calls, voicemail) aren't counted.
agentLogs.metrics.info.breakdown.topCust: Your most-used custom actions, ranked by how often your AI ran them.
agentLogs.metrics.info.breakdown.topDisc: Detailed reasons why calls ended. Useful for spotting patterns (e.g. lots of voicemails or busy signals).
agentLogs.metrics.info.breakdown.topHand: The reasons your AI handed conversations over to a teammate, ranked by how often each one happened. Great for spotting where your bot needs better instructions.
agentLogs.metrics.info.breakdown.topWork: Which workflows your AI fires most often. Helps you see which automations are actually being used.
agentLogs.metrics.info.callCompleted: Calls that ended normally — the customer or your AI hung up after a real conversation.
agentLogs.metrics.info.callTransfers: Calls that were transferred to another phone number or a teammate. Each call is counted once.
agentLogs.metrics.info.chart.avgCallDura: Average call length for each outcome (completed, voicemail, transferred, etc.). Helps you see which outcomes burn the most call time.
agentLogs.metrics.info.chart.avgDuration: Average time the AI itself spent processing each conversation, by day. Doesn't include user typing time or pauses.
agentLogs.metrics.info.chart.bookingConv: Daily booking conversion — the percent of customers who looked at slots and ended up booking. Days with no slot lookups show as 0%.
agentLogs.metrics.info.chart.businessAct: Daily activity by action type — see which kinds of actions are growing or slowing down.
agentLogs.metrics.info.chart.callDuratio: Voice AI calls grouped into five length buckets. Useful for spotting whether your AI is wrapping up quickly or getting stuck in long calls.
agentLogs.metrics.info.chart.latencyOver: Response time per message per day — each message's active processing time (its steps combined, with parallel/overlapping steps merged so nothing is double-counted, including internal steps), not counting infra wait time between steps. The average plus the p90/p95/p99 tail — the percentiles show what your slowest messages actually experience (p99 = the slowest 1%).
agentLogs.metrics.info.chart.modelLatenc: Average time for a single step on each AI model. This is per step, not a whole message's total. Helps you spot which models are slow.
agentLogs.metrics.info.chart.modelUsageO: How many AI steps ran on each model per day — shows which models your usage is shifting toward.
agentLogs.metrics.info.chart.voiceAiCall: Daily call volume, broken down by how each call ended.
agentLogs.metrics.info.contactInfoUpdate: Times your AI saved or updated information on a contact (name, email, custom fields, etc.).
agentLogs.metrics.info.customActions: Times your AI used a custom action you set up. Each use is counted separately.
agentLogs.metrics.info.endCallTool: Times your AI ended the call on its own (instead of the customer hanging up).
agentLogs.metrics.info.failed: Calls that couldn't go through because of a phone-system error. Worth investigating if this number is high.
agentLogs.metrics.info.followupsSchedule: Followups your AI scheduled, cancelled, or chained from a previous followup. Each event is counted separately — see the breakdown for the split.
agentLogs.metrics.info.humanAnswered: Calls where a real person picked up — either the customer talked to your AI, or the call was transferred to a teammate.
agentLogs.metrics.info.humanHandover: Times your AI handed the conversation over to a teammate. Each handoff is counted separately.
agentLogs.metrics.info.inCallAgentSwaps: Times one AI agent handed off to another AI agent inside the same call (a specialist or backup bot taking over without ending the call). Different from Call Transfers, which counts handoffs to a teammate or another phone number.
agentLogs.metrics.info.knowledgeBaseQuer: Times your AI looked up an answer from your knowledge base.
agentLogs.metrics.info.negativeSentiment: Share of analyzed calls where the customer sounded negative. Worth digging into when this trends up.
agentLogs.metrics.info.noAnswer: Calls where nobody picked up, or the line was busy.
agentLogs.metrics.info.positiveSentiment: Share of analyzed calls where the customer sounded positive or neutral. Calls without sentiment (web calls, voicemail) are left out, so the rate stays meaningful even on quiet days.
agentLogs.metrics.info.rejected: Calls the customer declined, hung up on immediately, or the carrier flagged as spam.
agentLogs.metrics.info.smsSent: Texts your AI sent during a call.
agentLogs.metrics.info.stopBot: Times your AI decided to stop responding in a conversation — for example, when the customer asked to be left alone.
agentLogs.metrics.info.totalCallDuration: Total time your AI spent on calls in this period.
agentLogs.metrics.info.totalCalls: All Voice AI calls handled in this period. Each call is counted once.
agentLogs.metrics.info.totalDuration: Total time the AI spent processing across all conversations in this period — adding up every model call, tool run, and Voice AI call.
agentLogs.metrics.info.voiceAiActionsTri: All business actions your AI ran during calls — bookings, reschedules, cancellations, workflows, contact updates, custom actions, and texts. Operational tools like knowledge-base lookups or call ends aren't counted.
agentLogs.metrics.info.voicemail: Calls that went to voicemail. Your AI either left a message or detected voicemail and stopped.
agentLogs.metrics.info.workflowsTriggere: Times your AI started a workflow during a chat or call.
